You are rebuilding one page of the **Nyxa Казахстан** template, a landing site (angle: fast-payout). Keep the section order, the content and every rule in the brief. Write the page text exactly as given (it is in Russian); write code and comments in English. If something in the brief is missing or unclear, ask instead of guessing, and never invent claims, figures, offers or reviews.

**Target stack:** WordPress with the SX ACF blocks (`sx/<block>` from `wp/sx-blocks.php`). If you use another stack (plain HTML/CSS, React/Next.js, another CMS), build one component per section with the listed fields as props.

## Acceptance checklist

- [ ] Sections appear in the order given, with the same layout variant (or an equivalent layout).
- [ ] All text is used exactly as given; nothing invented (no extra claims, figures, offers or reviews).
- [ ] One H1 per page; headings do not skip levels.
- [ ] No horizontal scrolling at 375px; tap targets at least 44px.
- [ ] Each page is under 64 KB of HTML and CSS (images excluded).
- [ ] The structured data listed for each page is present and valid.
- [ ] Every internal link opens an existing page.
- [ ] Text contrast meets WCAG AA, focus is visible, images have alt text.
- [ ] Every rule in the market guidance and the block rules holds on every page.

# Rebuild brief: Nyxa Казахстан

_Follow the system prompt (role, target stack, acceptance checklist) together with this brief._

## Site type guidance

- Purpose: sell one brand on one page and send the visitor to sign up. Every section leads to the same primary CTA.
- Keep exactly one primary CTA per section; the hero CTA must be above the fold at 375x667.
- The hero headline is at most 60 characters, the subtitle at most 160.
- Trust bar values (licence, payout time, payments) come from brand and market data; never type them by hand.
- Product sections (odds board, game strip, bonus banners) only show products the market allows.
- The sticky CTA appears on phones after the hero scrolls out of view.

## Market guidance

### Market context (from the market settings)

- Market: Kazakhstan (`kz`), languages ru, kk, currency KZT (₸)
- Minimum age: 21+
- Products allowed: sports, casino
- Promotions allowed: welcome_bonus, deposit_bonus, free_bets, promo_code, odds_boost, cashback, loyalty, tournaments
- Payment methods: Kaspi, Visa, Mastercard, Halyk
- App install paths: iOS app-store, Android apk

### Mandated texts (from the market settings)

- Age notice: Участие в азартных играх разрешено с 21 года.
- Licence: Лицензия РК
- Self-exclusion: Вы можете ограничить своё участие в азартных играх через eGov.

### Rules you must not break

- Every page opens with an age gate (21+) before any gambling content.
- Every page has the responsible-gambling panel (usually in the footer) with the market text: age notice, licence line, taglines, self-exclusion and helpline where given. Never type this text yourself; it comes from the market settings.
- Minimum age is 21: the age gate and every age line say 21+.
- Show only these payment methods: Kaspi, Visa, Mastercard, Halyk.
- Amounts are in KZT (₸).

### Market-specific rules

- Online bets are processed through the Unified Accounting Centre (ЕУЦ).
- Identification goes through eGov (or video identification); say so on sign-up pages.
- Self-limitation is available through eGov; mention it on responsible-gambling content.

## Site context

- Site: Nyxa Казахстан, brand or publisher: Nyxa
- Site type: landing, angle fast-payout; language `ru`, text direction `ltr`

Layout is mobile-first: it must work from 375px to 1440px wide.

## Block rules

- Header: One-page landing and app pages use 'minimal' (no nav) so attention stays on the conversion.
- Header: The CTA stays visible at every width; on mobile the nav collapses into a menu, the CTA does not.
- Hero: Exactly one primary CTA. The secondary action is a text link or ghost button.
- Hero: Primary CTA must sit above the fold at 375x667.
- Hero: Headline 60 characters max; subtitle 160 max (long Russian/Portuguese strings included).
- Hero: stat-led: the number must be a real brand fact (e.g. payout minutes) and match the trust bar.
- Trust bar: Values come from brand facts and market config; nothing is typed by hand.
- Trust bar: Rating shows only when the brand has facts.rating_source.
- Trust bar: Sits directly under the hero (section 2 or 3).
- Steps: Exactly 3 steps; numbers are used because the order is real.
- Steps: Mention verification and deposit limits honestly; do not promise instant approval.
- Features: 3 or 4 items. Titles 4 words max, text one sentence (about 120 characters).
- Features: Features describe the product, never an offer or bonus.
- Payments: Only methods listed in the market config may appear (no credit cards in AU or BR).
- Payments: Times are typical for verified accounts and say so in the note.
- FAQ: 4-6 questions: legality in the country, deposits/withdrawals, payout time, verification, limits or self-exclusion.
- FAQ: Answers are plain text, 1-3 sentences. No CTA links inside answers.
- Final CTA: Always the last section before the footer.
- Final CTA: Headline 40 characters max. No urgency claims (timers, 'last chance').
- Footer: Always renders the compliance panel; it cannot be switched off.
- Footer: Payment methods come from the market config so they are always locally correct.
- Responsible gambling: All copy comes from markets/<id>.json; never type compliance text into a page.
- Responsible gambling: Every page renders a 'panel' (usually inside the footer). 'strip' is an optional top-of-page addition.
- Responsible gambling: Where a market lists several mandated taglines, one is chosen per site by seed.
- Age gate: Age comes from the market (21 in KZ, 18 in AU/BR). Never hard-code it.
- Age gate: Content stays in the HTML for crawlers; the overlay is shown by script, so no-JS users still see the compliance footer.
- Sticky CTA: Phones only (860px and narrower). Never covers the compliance panel: the footer gets bottom padding.
- Sticky CTA: Shows the market age badge next to the CTA.

## Page

- Title tag: Nyxa: ставки на спорт с выводом на Kaspi за 5 минут
- Meta description: Лайв-ставки на футбол, хоккей и теннис. Пополнение и вывод через Kaspi и Halyk. Лицензия РК. 21+.
- The only H1: Ставки на спорт с выводом за 5 минут
- Structured data (JSON-LD): WebPage, FAQPage

### Sections, in order

1. **Header** — block `sx/header`, variant `minimal-split`, role `header`
   Purpose: Site header with logo, navigation and primary CTA.
   - `sticky`: false
   - `show_cta`: true
2. **Hero** — block `sx/hero`, variant `stat-led`, role `hero`
   Purpose: Above-the-fold hero: headline, one primary CTA, trust row and an optional offer/feature card.
   - `eyebrow`: "Вывод на Kaspi"
   - `title`: "Ставки на спорт с выводом за 5 минут"
   - `subtitle`: "Лайв-ставки на футбол, хоккей и теннис. Пополнение и вывод через Kaspi и Halyk."
   - `secondary`: `{"label":"Способы оплаты","url":"#payments"}`
   - `show_trust`: true
   - `stat`: `{"value":"5","unit":"мин","caption":"среднее время вывода на Kaspi Gold для верифицированных игроков"}`
   - `art`: "rings"
3. **Trust bar** — block `sx/trust-bar`, variant `badges`, role `trust`
   Purpose: Licence, payout time, years operating, local payments and (only if sourced) rating.
   - `items`: `["licence","payout","since","payments"]`
4. **Steps** — block `sx/steps`, variant `timeline`, role `content`
   Purpose: Three real steps from sign-up to first bet, followed by the mid-page CTA.
   - `eyebrow`: "Начало"
   - `title`: "Три шага до первой ставки"
   - `items`: `[{"title":"Регистрация","text":"Укажите телефон и пройдите идентификацию через eGov. Обычно это занимает пару минут."},{"title":"Пополнение","text":"От 500 ₸ через Kaspi, Halyk или карту Visa и Mastercard."},{"title":"Ставка","text":"Выберите событие, добавьте его в купон и подтвердите."}]`
   - `show_cta`: true
5. **Features** — block `sx/features`, variant `rows`, role `content`
   Purpose: 3-4 product reasons to join, each with an icon, a short title and one sentence.
   - `eyebrow`: "Почему Nyxa"
   - `title`: "Быстро на каждом шаге"
   - `items`: `[{"icon":"bolt","title":"Мгновенное пополнение","text":"Деньги на счёте сразу после оплаты в Kaspi или по карте."},{"icon":"chart","title":"Живая линия","text":"Коэффициенты обновляются в реальном времени, пока идёт матч."},{"icon":"mobile","title":"Всё в приложении","text":"Ставки, вывод и история операций в одном приложении для iOS и Android."},{"icon":"gauge","title":"Лимиты под контролем","text":"Установите лимит депозита или сделайте паузу в пару касаний."}]`
6. **Payments** — block `sx/payments`, variant `table`, role `content`
   Purpose: Local deposit and withdrawal methods with speed and minimums.
   - `eyebrow`: "Kaspi, Halyk, карты"
   - `title`: "Пополнение и вывод"
   - `rows`: `[{"method":"kaspi","deposit":"Мгновенно","withdraw":"~5 мин","min":"500 ₸"},{"method":"halyk","deposit":"Мгновенно","withdraw":"~15 мин","min":"500 ₸"},{"method":"visa","label":"Visa / Mastercard","deposit":"Мгновенно","withdraw":"до 1 дня","min":"1 000 ₸"}]`
   - `note`: "Сроки указаны для верифицированных аккаунтов."
7. **FAQ** — block `sx/faq`, variant `columns`, role `content`
   Purpose: Answers the objections that stop sign-ups. Emits FAQPage structured data.
   - `items`: `[{"q":"Nyxa работает легально в Казахстане?","a":"Да. Nyxa принимает ставки на спорт по лицензии Республики Казахстан. Онлайн-казино в Казахстане запрещено, поэтому доступны только ставки на спорт."},{"q":"Как быстро приходят выплаты?","a":"Вывод на Kaspi обычно занимает около 5 минут, на банковскую карту — до одного рабочего дня."},{"q":"С какого возраста можно делать ставки?","a":"С 21 года. Возраст проверяется при регистрации."},{"q":"Нужна ли идентификация?","a":"Да. По закону все игроки проходят идентификацию, обычно через eGov."},{"q":"Как ограничить себя?","a":"В настройках можно задать лимиты депозита и ставок. Также можно ограничить участие в азартных играх через eGov."}]`
8. **Final CTA** — block `sx/cta-band`, variant `split`, role `content`
   Purpose: The last push before the footer: short headline, the CTA and two proof points.
   - `title`: "Ставки без ожидания"
   - `text`: "Регистрация займёт пару минут. Лимиты можно задать сразу."
   - `show_code`: false
9. **Footer** — block `sx/footer`, variant `compact`, role `footer`
   Purpose: Footer with links, payment methods, the compliance panel and copyright.
   - `show_verify`: false
  - inside it: **Responsible gambling** — block `sx/compliance-bar`, variant `panel`
     - `show_verify`: false
10. **Age gate** — block `sx/age-gate`, variant `modal`, role `age-gate`
   Purpose: Age confirmation overlay using the market's minimum age. Remembers the answer for 30 days.
   - `leave_url`: "https://www.google.com"
   - `preview`: false
11. **Sticky CTA** — block `sx/sticky-cta`, variant `pill`, role `sticky`
   Purpose: Bottom CTA on phones. Appears once the hero CTA scrolls away; hides while the final CTA is on screen.

_Long text and lists are shortened here (…, "[n items]"). For the full text run `php build/ai-brief.php sites/demos/<config>.json`._
